nom: SUNDAY RILEY B3 Nice 10% Niacinamide Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily T-zone skin report reduced oiliness, smaller pores, and fewer breakouts with continued use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report severe irritation, itching, welts, or sunburn-like redness that stopped use, while one long-term sensitive-skin user reports good absorption and reduced redness with no reaction.
segments.mature: Reviewers citing age-related concerns report smaller-looking pores, smoother texture, and diminished fine lines/wrinkles.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer describes reduced dryness alongside a counteracted oily T-zone.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry patches reports the serum softens and hydrates without feeling greasy.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for visible pores, uneven texture, and early wrinkles report smaller-looking pores, smoother texture, and diminishing under-eye wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports the serum hydrates dry patches without greasiness; no other dehydration-specific reports are present.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers citing redness (including rosacea and general redness-prone skin) report visible calming and less redness over weeks; however, several sensitive-skin users report the opposite, developing sunburn-like redness, welts, or itching after use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe reactive, itchy, tight skin or scarring from a burn-like reaction, suggesting barrier disruption in susceptible users; no reviewer reports barrier-repair benefits specifically.
concerns.spots: Reviewers targeting dark spots and sun damage report noticeable fading, in some cases outperforming prescription creams or retinols.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne scars report visible improvement in scarring within weeks to months; one hormonal-acne sufferer reports no effect at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily complexions report a visible decrease in oiliness and shine; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Risk of burning or irritation on application

extraits.texte: This did nothing for my skin, I suffer from Hormonal acne and clogged pores and redness + inflammation all over. I keep trying to consistently use but it doesnt do anything at all

I received a sample bottle of Sunday Riley's Niacinamide serum and was so excited to try it as I love other products from this brand. I used a small amount before going to bed and I woke up with what looks like a sunburn. My skin is red, irritated, itchy and tight. I'm using a cortisone cream to try and tame it. If you have skin that is sensitive, you might want to do a patch test before using.

I received this in my Allure beauty box. I used it twice a day for a good while and my skin looked and felt great. Then all the sudden it started causing welts, redness and scaliness. I didn't think it could be this product so I stopped all products until my skin calmed down. I tried using this product again and the same thing happened. This brand in general causes a lot of irritation in my skin unfortunately. I think the products work but at a huge cost. I don't even consider myself to have sensitive skin. I can't imagine how this would be for someone with actual sensitive skin.

I wasn't sure how I felt about using a standalone niacinimide, but after trying I love this serum. I love that it has resveratrol and egcg in it also, which are great antioxidants besides vit c. I feel this is a great serum for antiaging and helps reduce dryness and counteracts my oily t-zone. My skin is smooth and appears clear. Love the smooth texture of product, really feels luxurious. I do use other sunday riley products and they all compliment each other well.

extraits.titre: Redness reducer & pore improved (AND I have sensitive skin!)
extraits.texte: I love this. I alternate between this in the morning and Peach and Lily Glass Skin serum at night. I have pretty sensitive skin. Like, can't tolerate neutrogena sensitive skin. So I cautiously purchased my first bottle. it goes on really nicely and is fairly absorbant into the skin within a minute or two. Almost to the bottom of bottle #2.

I've had decently bad acne all of my life up into my 30s, and once I started using this product my acne has pretty much disappeared (save for maybe one pimple during periods) and my scarring has disappeared.

Love this so much!!! An associate recommended this to me while shopping. Im acne prone and oliy skin my entire life. I finally find something that works and is true to its claim!! Buy this i know its 65 bucks but its worth it! A little goes a along way, on my second bottle and last me 2 months. Im glowing and finally comfortable in my skin!
